note: Extension AIX-D1: an audience variant (executive | sop | audit) of ONE generated document. The model writes paragraphs bound to fact ids; the server keeps a paragraph only if every fact id is in the pack, every number and every role word comes from the referenced facts, and the text is plain; a mandatory section without a kept paragraph makes the whole variant a labelled deterministic fallback. Unknowns, limits and the canonical fact table are always rendered by the server. Pinned in docs/evaluation/FINAL_AI_QUALITY_PLAN.md.

executive.title: Executive summary of the business knowledge

headings.decisions_needed: Decisions people still have to make

executive.guidance: Write for a director who has three minutes: what the rules achieve, where money or control is at risk, what is still undecided. Every material risk must cite the rule or question it comes from.

sop.title: Standard operating procedure derived from the business knowledge
sop.guidance: Write for the person who performs the process: one step per paragraph, in the order the conditions are checked, naming the role that acts, the exact condition and what happens. Keep every exception of the cited rules; invent none.

audit.title: Audit reading of the business knowledge
audit.guidance: Write for an auditor: one paragraph per control (rule) stating who acts, the threshold or condition, the outcome and whether a person decided it or it is only observed in the sources. Every paragraph cites exactly the rule(s) it describes.
